origins: Commons public file descriptions/categories accessed 2026-11-05, original binaries NOT fetched
policy: 43 Places are the original R26 undecided/no-original set; 19 earlier R28 owner selections and the held Aachen image are separate and unchanged.
Only source role COVER_REVIEW_CANDIDATE may be chosen as a future cover subject; none is a current rights or byte-approved original.

An editorial pick is a preference, not a public release; exact original SHA1+bytes, author, photographic rights, specific subject, architecture/sculpture rights and mobile composition must be checked.
The archived Liniers photograph, small Zeitoun file, Talawila statue, Litchfield TIFF group and known undersized sources may be shown for context but cannot be promoted as covers.
Do not scrape restricted source images, request payments, contact photo owners, substitute photographs, or bypass Commons rate limits.
Many other Places have only custodian/site information or inadequate geotags. They remain visible as unsourced, not assigned false photograph candidates.
Reopen source discovery only for the remaining unsourced 33 Places, not sites where good exact source filenames are already available.
